dialogue.speaker: passenger
dialogue.text: Bro, what's the difference between a component speaker and a coaxial speaker?

dialogue.speaker: driver
dialogue.text: Good question! Both are car speakers, but their design and sound performance are different.

dialogue.speaker: driver
dialogue.text: A component speaker has separate woofers and tweeters with a crossover. This allows better speaker positioning, sound separation and sound staging.

dialogue.speaker: driver
dialogue.text: A coaxial speaker combines the woofer and tweeter into one unit. It's compact, convenient and easier to install.

dialogue.speaker: driver
dialogue.text: So, for better sound staging and flexible positioning, choose component speakers. For a simple and convenient upgrade, coaxial speakers are a great option.
